FX-DIRT-001.says: Soft Physical Glow, radius 12, with the 6 by 4 smudge as its dirt, every dirt setting as added (opacity 100, inherit 0, exposure 0, gamma 1, repeat on): the smudge, mirror-repeated over the whole grown layer, shows where the glow is bright, in its own colours, brightest beside the yellow patch.

FX-DIRT-002.says: Repeat Edges off: the smudge only in the middle, columns 5 to 10 and rows 3 to 6; elsewhere FX-SGLOW-001's glow.

FX-DIRT-003.says: Inherit Glow Color 100: the matte is the glow channel by channel, so the dirt takes the glow's warm colour.

FX-DIRT-004.says: Inherit Glow Color 50: halfway between FX-DIRT-001's matte and FX-DIRT-003's.

FX-DIRT-005.says: Matte Exposure 2: the matte four times as bright, held at 1, so the dirt shows further out from the patches.

FX-DIRT-006.says: Matte Exposure -2: the matte a quarter as bright, the dirt fainter.

FX-DIRT-007.says: Matte Gamma 2.2: the matte's faint parts raised, the dirt reaching further into the glow's tail.

FX-DIRT-008.says: Matte Gamma 0.5: the matte squared, the dirt only where the glow is strongest.

FX-DIRT-009.says: Opacity 0: no dirt, FX-SGLOW-001's glow exactly.

FX-DIRT-011.says: Opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the glow alone, frame 2 FX-DIRT-010, frame 4 FX-DIRT-001.

FX-DIRT-012.says: The 20 by 12 specks, bigger than the layer: centred, its two red edge columns fall in the grown ring outside the drawing, past the comp's view; the specks show where the glow is bright.

FX-DIRT-013.says: Moved three pixels right: the glow and its dirt move together, the dirt lying on the layer.

FX-DIRT-014.says: Tint core to edge (white to blue) with Inherit 100: the dirt takes the tinted glow's colour, bluer away from the patches.

FX-DIRT-015.says: Blend Mode Add, Exposure 3: the glow not held at 1, the matte held at 1, so the dirt is never brighter than itself.

FX-DIRT-016.says: A dirt layer that is not in the composition, `gone`: the layer drawn without the effect, and the warning every frame.

FX-DIRT-017.says: Lens Flare as added on the photo with the smudge as its dirt: the smudge lit where the flare is bright, round its core at (4.8, 3) and on its ghosts.

FX-DIRT-018.says: Lens Flare, Inherit Glow Color 100: the dirt takes the flare's colours.

FX-DIRT-019.says: Lens Flare, Blend With Original 50: halfway between FX-DIRT-017 and the photo.

FX-DIRT-020.says: Lens Flare, Brightness 0: no light, so no matte and no dirt: the photo untouched.

FX-DIRT-021.says: Lens Flare, Repeat Edges off, Matte Exposure 3: the dirt only in the middle, strong.

FX-DIRT-022.says: Lens Flare, no dirt layer named: FX-FLARE-001 exactly.

FX-DIRT-023.says: Soft Physical Glow, dirt opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRT-024.says: Soft Physical Glow, dirt inherit -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRT-025.says: Soft Physical Glow, dirt exposure 11, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRT-026.says: Soft Physical Glow, dirt gamma 0.05, below 0.1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRT-027.says: Soft Physical Glow, dirt repeat written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRT-028.says: Lens Flare, dirt opacity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRT-029.says: Lens Flare, dirt gamma keyed to 11 at frame 4, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
